in_sanskrit.name: श्रीलाथा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows wealth and prosperity. Derived from the words श्री (Shree), meaning wealth, and लाथा (Latha), meaning Goddess.

in_hindi.name: श्रीलाथा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a manifestation of wealth and prosperity. The name is derived from the words श्री (Shree), meaning wealth, and लाथा (Latha), meaning Goddess.

in_tamil.name: ஷ்ரீலாதா

in_telugu.name: శ్రీళాద

in_marathi.name: Shreelatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreelatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shri represents wealth, prosperity, and fortune in Hinduism. Latha means 'waves' or 'steps'. This name is often given to girls to invoke the blessings of the Goddess of wealth and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Shreelatha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shreelatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Shri represents wealth, prosperity, and fortune in Hinduism. Latha means 'waves' or 'steps'. This name is often given to girls to invoke the blessings of the Goddess of wealth and prosperity.
